Welcome to Nevra Stays Hosted by Gaurav

Welcome to Nevra Stays — a personalized high-rise retreat perched on the 32nd floor of Supernova, Noida. Designed for discerning travelers seeking elegance, relaxation, and memorable moments.

Whether you are catching the golden hour horizon from the balcony, savoring a home-cooked dinner in the fully equipped kitchen, or resting on plush king linens, everything has been designed to make you feel right at home above the clouds.
